_comment: Scenario to services map for the E2E suite. Read by scripts/ci-select.sh (which scenarios a service-only PR runs); checked by scripts/check-e2e-map.sh (every e2e-tagged Test function has an entry, no entry names a missing function). A service is listed when the scenario drives or asserts on any of its binaries; when in doubt, list it. Services: identity, course, analytics, notification, publishing, audit. See docs/guides/ci.md.

TestE2E_E01_HappyPath.note: whole pipeline: register, publish, enroll, complete, certificate, mail, audit

TestE2E_E02_OneTraceAcrossPipeline.note: one trace id across every binary

TestE2E_E03_DuplicateDelivery.note: duplicate Kafka delivery consumed by analytics, notification, audit

TestE2E_E04_PoisonMessage.note: poison event parked by analytics-worker, failed_events in the audit store

TestE2E_E05_KafkaDownThenUp.note: broker outage while publishes and enrollments flow

TestE2E_E10_RedisFlushWithNewServices.note: FLUSHALL: token versions re-seeded across the APIs

TestE2E_E11_SchemaIncompatibility.note: schema registry bootstrap and incompatible schema; every binary registers subjects

TestE2E_E12_PublishUnderFault.note: publish workflow under Temporal and worker faults

TestE2E_E13_ArchiveAndAudit.note: audit archive of every event, replay, graceful restart

TestE2E_E14_AuthAndAccessOnNewSurface.note: authorization matrix over audit-api, analytics, certificates, admin routes

TestE2E_InstructorAfterRedisRestart_Logi.note: F-38: token version re-seed after a Redis restart

TestE2E_DataIndependence_RolesAndOutboxe.note: per-service roles and outboxes through the real stack

TestE2E_Adversarial_Surface.note: security pass over every binary's surface

TestAdversarial_CertificateNeedsNameMirr.note: certificate issuer vs instructor-mirror consumer stall

TestAdversarial_MongoOutage_BeyondDefaul.note: MongoDB outage beyond the retry budget

TestAdversarial_TwoWorkerReplicas_Killed.note: two replicas of every stateful worker killed in turn
